admission.justification: Archive publication and retry validation in worktrees/integration/terminal_enclosure_archive.py and models/lifecycles/enclosure.py prevent silently overriding accepted cleanup arguments across retries.

applicability: Retries of already-accepted terminal archives in worktree cleanup and finalize.
conditions: Once a terminal archive is published, retries validate against its saved operation and cleanupArguments via cleanup_arguments_match.
Pre-removal archives carrying a legacy teardown_providers field still validate and retry cleanly under narrowed public cleanupArguments ({} or {force}).
exclusions: Pre-archive provider-skip checks for teardown_providers=False, which were removed with search providers under 261125-DEP-L2.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Once a terminal archive is published, retries preserve its saved operation and cleanupArguments, accepting legacy teardown_providers fields when comparing public arguments.
title: Terminal cleanup archives preserve saved operation and retry arguments
